intensity_fraction.label: Rainfall concentration · rainiest-day rainfall divided by total event rainfall
intensity_fraction.definition: Rainfall concentration is the rainfall on the event's rainiest single day divided by total rainfall over the whole event. A positive trend means a larger one-day share; a negative trend means a smaller one-day share.

ssi_1d.label: Antecedent wetness · mean SSI over 1 day before rainfall onset
ssi_1d.definition: Mean SSI over the complete day before event rainfall begins.

ssi_3d.label: Antecedent wetness · mean SSI over 3 days before rainfall onset
ssi_3d.definition: Mean SSI over the three complete days before event rainfall begins.

ssi_7d.label: Antecedent wetness · mean SSI over 7 days before rainfall onset
ssi_7d.definition: Mean SSI over the seven complete days before event rainfall begins.

ssi_30d.label: Antecedent wetness · mean SSI over 30 days before rainfall onset
ssi_30d.definition: Mean SSI over the thirty complete days before event rainfall begins.
